🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; confirmations: sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals/financials leading (JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND, CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials breadth strong alongside Financials: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND. Communication showing softness and dispersion; Technology mixed with large winners and many software names BELOW TREND (see below).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.64% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.23% | 1M: -17.67%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION, PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in incumbent software and energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged — multiple large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatch (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY); watch for trend confirmation and possible tactical reversals.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is bifurcated: semiconductors and select infra names ABOVE TREND (INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +19.63%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +6.61%) ABOVE TREND) while software/cloud names are BELOW TREND (CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND). Net: rotation within Tech from software to semiconductors.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive with breadth positive and leaders ABOVE TREND: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND; cyclicals within Financials supporting the RISK-ON backdrop. V/MA show short-term 1W strength vs 1M weakness (V (1W: +1.18% | 1M: -1.49%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, MA (1W: +1.23% | 1M: -0.89%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL) — monitor follow-through.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed but not leading defensives: UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL versus JNJ (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth modestly positive; not a defensive bid driving the market.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value tilt within the RISK-ON regime: favor JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND; also favor select semiconductors (INTC, LRCX). Reduce exposure to lagging large-cap software names showing structural weakness (CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND); style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth-only.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: +9.64% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY — watch sentiment/legal overhang.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +4.82%) and Industrials (1W: +4.13%) given strong internals and breakout names. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.25%) and Communication (1W: -0.86%) where weakness and headline risk persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA near short-term resistance for continuation (NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND); AMZN retest of breakout support to confirm follow-through (AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND); JPM above prior breakout level to confirm financials-led extension (JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (+70): Bezos AI bet headline; price AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. UNH (+70): Medicare rate lift; price UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed. GOOGL (+55): Anthropic deal catalyst; price GOOGL (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed. LLY (+60): obesity push; LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — news bullish but full price confirmation pending.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PSX (-55): derivatives loss headline; PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. CRM (-50): data breach/layoffs; CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. META (-50): lawsuit pressure; META (1W: +9.64% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY — negative sentiment versus short-term price bounce, divergence to monitor. IBM (-45): target cuts ahead of earnings; IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. PFE (-45): lowered PT; PFE (1W: -4.94% | 1M: -1.39%) BELOW TREND — confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style. INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (AAPL RECOVERY, META RECOVERY vs CRM/ADBE NOW BELOW TREND) and mixed sentiment on tech — watch for trend confirmation.
